notes: Volunteer Office: (949) 452-3728, 24451 Health Center Dr, Laguna Hills. The application PDF is labeled an adult form; ask the office which form teens use.
name: Saddleback Medical Center Volunteer
what_you_do: Volunteer in the hospital as part of the patient care team. You work in service areas. After an interview, the Volunteer Office finds you an opening.
who_can_apply: Anyone 16 or older. Those 18 and over also pass a background check and need a valid Social Security number. You commit to 150 hours a year.
pay_detail: Unpaid. You buy a volunteer uniform jacket ($25) and pay $5 in dues.
how_to_apply: Fill out the application form (PDF on the page). Email it to the volunteer office, addressed to Julia Lieberman. Then go to a Volunteer Services orientation. You also need 2 TB tests and the required seasonal flu shot. The page does not mention an interview.
